Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.

callTranscripts.summary: Richard was billed for four hours, but he claims the cleaners were only there for about an hour and a half. Richard expressed concern about being charged for time not worked and stated he prefers fairness in billing. Tidyups Cleaning acknowledged the misunderstanding and agreed to adjust the invoice from $240 to $180 for an hour and a half of work. Richard confirmed the cleaners arrived at 02:26 PM and left at 04:31 PM. Tidyups Cleaning assured Richard that his cleaners do not try to extend their time unnecessarily and are honest about their work. Richard mentioned he used to work with cleaners frequently in leasing and is interested in establishing an ongoing cleaning arrangement. Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.

callTranscripts.summary: Richard was billed for four hours, but he claims the cleaners were only there for about an hour and a half. Richard expressed concern about being charged for time not worked and stated he prefers fairness in billing. Tidyups Cleaning acknowledged the misunderstanding and agreed to adjust the invoice from $240 to $180 for an hour and a half of work. Richard confirmed the cleaners arrived at 02:26 PM and left at 04:31 PM. Tidyups Cleaning assured Richard that his cleaners do not try to extend their time unnecessarily and are honest about their work. Richard mentioned he used to work with cleaners frequently in leasing and is interested in establishing an ongoing cleaning arrangement. Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.

callTranscripts.summary: The caller, Paige, is looking for cleaning services after a renovation at their home in Leduc, Edmonton. Paige mentioned they are living in their basement and garage due to ongoing renovations and need help cleaning up cement dust and debris left by the renovation company. Tidyups Cleaning confirmed they can provide cleaning services and suggested sending a quote after gathering information. Paige provided the address: 7 Alpaugh Crest, which has 1,400 square feet on the main floor, including a kitchen, two living rooms, a dining room, and one bathroom. The main floor has hardwood and tile flooring, with no rugs. Tidyups Cleaning estimated the cleaning cost to be between $300 and $500. They discussed the possibility of organizing services, with the option to have cleaners help unpack and organize items as needed. Tidyups Cleaning agreed to send a quote for three hours of cleaning with two cleaners, allowing for additional time if necessary.
